description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to Levied an excise duty per bulk liter of foreign liquor imported to Sri Lanka under the Excise Ordinance, w.e.f. 13.03.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the establishment of new excise duties and import regulations for foreign liquor. It is issued under the authority of the Excise Ordinance, constitutes a regulatory framework for importation and taxation, and rescinds previous notifications. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory matters, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments. While a government minister is named, the content's primary focus is on establishing regulations, not on the personnel appointment or their detailed portfolio responsibilities, so government Types 1-3 do not take precedence.
